name: SPT-CL J0404-4418 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0404-4418, a galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj04044418-webb
story: Webb visited this galaxy cluster for SLICE, a survey that uses the way massive clusters bend and magnify the light of more distant galaxies to map where their mass lies and to follow how clusters evolve.

claims.text: SLICE (Strong LensIng and Cluster Evolution) is JWST program 5594
SLICE targets galaxy clusters, drawn from a parent list of clusters
SLICE uses NIRCam imaging to derive strong-lensing mass maps of clusters
SPT-CL clusters are galaxy clusters selected by the South Pole Telescope through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
